rationale: DOI:10.1002/cbic.201000672 reports targeted cpaH inactivation in native Aspergillus oryzae and loss of 2-oxocyclopiazonic acid production; the evidence demonstrates the BGC0000977 locus.

PMID:20536237 reports in vitro incubation of recombinant Streptomyces avermitilis SAV_76 with farnesyl diphosphate to form avermitilol; the evidence demonstrates the BGC0000683 locus without upgrading the native producer claim.

DOI:10.1093/femsle/fnw139 reports native Serratia plymuthica 4Rx13 knockout evidence for SOD_c20760 and SOD_c20780, and DOI:10.1021/jacs.8b08510 reports in-vitro SodC/SodD reconstitution from farnesyl diphosphate to sodorifen; the evidence demonstrates the BGC0001361 locus and native producer claim.

DOI:10.1021/ja111279h reports recombinant Streptomyces arenae PntM converting pentalenolactone F to pentalenolactone and native pntM deletion blocking pentalenolactone production; the evidence demonstrates the BGC0000653 locus and native producer claim.
PMID:11562468 reconstitutes Stigmatella AF299336.1 MxcE/MxcF/MxcG-dependent myxochelin A formation in vitro; the evidence demonstrates this locus without upgrading the native producer claim.

PMID:27403888 characterizes Streptomyces pristinaespiralis ATCC 25486 pristinol synthase converting farnesyl diphosphate to pristinol; the evidence demonstrates the BGC0001746 locus without upgrading the native producer claim.

DOI:10.1016/S1074-5521(02)00285-5 reports a 3.8 kb Streptomyces noursei DNA fragment directing albonoursin biosynthesis in Streptomyces lividans; the evidence demonstrates the BGC0000851 locus without upgrading the native producer claim.

DOI:10.1073/pnas.1419964112 reports native Streptomyces griseus subsp. griseus ATCC 12648 ind-cluster knockouts that abolish indolmycin production and in-vitro Ind7 methylation of N-demethylindolmycin to indolmycin; the evidence demonstrates the BGC0001206 locus and native producer claim.

MIBiG BGC0000892 version 4 assigns the experiments to Burkholderia caryophylli DSM50341 (KJ815051-KJ815060), not Burkholderia gladioli BSR3. Those experiments do not support experimental grades for the BSR3 CP002599.1 locus or its producer claim. Retain the original BSR3 source assertion without inferring homology-based prediction.
